method: manual visual transcription from pixels: read review-protocol.md, then preflight.json; its images array was empty. Saved and tool-read reviews/craft-action-first.json with empty viewed/readings before opening packet.json. The preflight record remains unchanged. Then read the complete packet request/copy/conditions and called view_image on every exact native, usage720 and thumbnail320 path, 15 actual calls. All calls requested detail original and returned original; no viewer failure, cropped substitute, OCR, image alteration, web access, connector, agent or peer file was used. Six complete supplied strings were manually read at native and usage720 for each image; thumbnail readings are limited as recorded per image. Required strings are exact packet copy; observed strings preserve the manual readings, including the two-line action sentence in X2337; equal normalizes whitespace only. PNG headers were read only to verify actual dimensions: 1536x1024 landscape, two 1024x1536 portraits, two 1254x1254 squares; all native target ratio errors are 0%, and the requested 2 portrait/2 square/1 landscape count is met. Exact usage720 paths are 720 pixels wide: landscape 720x480, portraits 720x1080, squares 720x720. Portrait thumbnail paths are 213x320, landscape 320x213, squares 320x320. Static views cannot establish hidden contact faces, actual lever motion, spring composition, physical holding performance, print suitability or authorship. Mandatory pass includes the shared requirement to keep the product structure consistent across all five; a series continuity failure is therefore recorded for every member even when local conditions are met. Integer closest_pair.score uses the same diversity scale as set diversity: 1 most repetitive, 5 most distinct. No scores were averaged; no later rubric was added.
